framework.name: laravel
framework.notes: 'none' = no JS meta-framework router; this is a server-rendered Laravel app (Blade views + package-level PHP route files + a Vue 3.5 island layer mounted on them). NOT react-vite: there are ZERO .vue files and ZERO React/vite-react deps in the repo - the 1.34 MB of TypeScript is 307 Playwright end-to-end page-object files under packages/Webkul/*/tests/e2e-pw/, and Vite is used only as the asset bundler. Frontend stack pinned from packages/Webkul/{Shop,Admin}/package.json: vue ^3.5.13, vue-router absent, @vitejs/plugin-vue ^5.2.4, vee-validate ^4.9.1, vue-flatpickr, flatpickr, vuedraggable, tailwindcss ^3.3.2, vite ^6.4.2; the storefront mounts Vue via createApp() from vue/dist/vue.esm-bundler in packages/Webkul/Shop/src/Resources/assets/js/app.js. Backend is a Laravel 12 modular monolith: 41 self-contained packages under packages/Webkul/ (Admin, Shop, Product, Sales, Stripe, ...) wired through konekt/concord, 2,621 PHP files in packages/, 243 models, 103 repositories.

node_or_python_requirement: PHP >=8.3 <8.5 with ext-calendar, curl, intl, mbstring, openssl, pdo, pdo_mysql, tokenizer; Node: no engines field pinned, but Vite ^6 requires Node >=18/20 (built assets are committed so a build is not required to run)

workspaces: composer path repositories -> packages/*/* (41 Webkul packages, symlinked via repositories[0] type=path url=packages/*/*)
monorepo.notes: One Laravel app shell (app/, config/, routes/, bootstrap/, database/) + 41 in-repo Composer packages under packages/Webkul/*, each with its own composer.json, package.json, tailwind.config.js, vite.config.js and tests. This is a monorepo by Composer path-repository, not an npm workspace. Frontend assets build PER PACKAGE (cd packages/Webkul/Admin && npm install && npm run build), not from the root - the root package.json only builds resources/css/app.css + resources/js/app.js.

auth.notes: Own Laravel guards, no SaaS. Customer guard (session) + admin guard with ACL roles/permissions (Webkul/User), email verification, password reset, TOTP 2FA + backup codes via pragmarx/google2fa (Admin/src/Http/Controllers/User/TwoFactorController.php), social login via laravel/socialite + Webkul/SocialLogin, REST auth via laravel/sanctum. orm value 'eloquent' is outside the contract's enum (drizzle/prisma/sqlmodel/typeorm) because none of those apply to PHP - Eloquent + konekt/concord proxy/repository pattern is what is actually used (103 repositories).

pages: /{slug} and /{category}/{slug} -> ProductsCategoriesProxyController fallback (the whole catalog rides a catch-all)
/admin/* (prefix = config app.admin_url, default 'admin'; 13 admin route files)
routes.notes: count=511 is a COUNTED total of Route::get/post/put/patch/delete/any/resource declarations across the 25 of 26 route files that declare routes (Paypal/src/Routes/web.php declares none inline). 41 of those are the /api/* group, 3 are checkout, 20 store-front, 53 customer, 2 webmcp, 4 stripe. There are no Next.js-style files - routing is PHP route files per package under packages/Webkul/*/src/Routes/ (Admin has 13 files: sales 82, settings 74, marketing 58, catalog 44, customers 39, ...).

env.notes: 60 names counted from .env.example (exactly 60 KEY= lines; the names above ARE that full list). No value is a real credential - APP_KEY, DB_PASSWORD, MAIL_*, AWS_* are empty or example placeholders (shop@example.com / admin@example.com / contact@example.com). Required-at-startup, not build: APP_KEY is empty and must be generated (`php artisan key:generate`; composer's post-create-project-cmd does it) or every request fails; DB_DATABASE/DB_USERNAME/DB_PASSWORD are empty with DB_CONNECTION=mysql (port 3306). Names read via env() in config/ but ABSENT from .env.example and therefore easy to miss: ELASTICSEARCH_HOST/USER/PASS (config/elasticsearch.php), APP_PORT/WWWGROUP/FORWARD_* (docker-compose.yml), and all gateway keys - Stripe/PayPal/Razorpay/PayU/PhonePe/PayGlocal credentials and MagicAI provider keys are stored in admin configuration, not in .env. SECRETS CHECK: no secret VALUE is committed in any tracked file; only NAMES appear (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, DB_PASSWORD).

deploy.build_cmd: composer install (repo itself is a Laravel project; the alternative is `composer create-project bagisto/bagisto`); frontend assets optional: cd packages/Webkul/{Admin,Shop,Installer} && npm install && npm run build
deploy.start_cmd: php artisan serve (dev) or php artisan bagisto:install on a fresh DB; production image: one `docker run` boots nginx|apache|litespeed + php-fpm + bundled mysql|mariadb under supervisor
deploy.migrations_cmd: php artisan migrate  (or `php artisan bagisto:install` which runs migrations+seeders+assets); 192 migration files; `php artisan up`/`down` for maintenance, `php artisan optimize:clear` after config changes
deploy.notes: Two independent docker setups: (1) docker-compose.yml = Laravel Sail for DEV with laravel.test (built from vendor/laravel/sail/runtimes/8.3 - note this path only exists AFTER composer install), mysql/mysql-server:8.0, redis:alpine, elasticsearch 7.17 + kibana 7.17, mailpit; exposes ${APP_PORT:-80} and ${VITE_PORT:-5173}. (2) docker/production/* = a published single-container PRODUCTION image (webkul/bagisto) in 6 combinations: nginx(default)|apache|litespeed x mysql(default)|mariadb, run at http://localhost:8080, with shared/entrypoint.sh + build-install.sh that run migrations and seed on first boot. No PHP-FPM/nginx config is committed at the app root, and no .next-style standalone output (N/A for PHP).

tests.notes: 153 *Test.php files across 13 packages (Admin, Shop, Core, Customer, DataGrid, EUWithdrawal, FPC, Installer, Payment, PayGlocal, PayU, Razorpay, Stripe); phpunit.xml defines 20+ named testsuites and sets APP_ENV=testing / CACHE_STORE=array / MAIL_MAILER=array. 307 Playwright e2e files (packages/Webkul/*/tests/e2e-pw/, page-object pattern) - that is where the TypeScript language share comes from. pest-tests.yml is a real matrix over MySQL 8.0 AND MariaDB 10.11. Repo AGENTS.md names four gates (Pint, Pest, Playwright, translations) and says 'a gate you did not run is a gate that failed'.

pitfalls.detail: The repo description and README sell 'multi-vendor marketplace', but there is NO marketplace code in this repo: 0 occurrences of 'marketplace', 'seller' or 'vendor'-as-seller across all 3,856 tracked paths (the only 'vendor' hit is a bundled JS chunk named vendor-*.js). Multi-vendor is a separate paid/commercial Bagisto extension. Do not promise a marketplace from this template alone.
pitfalls.evidence: git/trees/2.4?recursive=1 grepped case-insensitively for marketplace|seller|vendor -> 0 code hits; composer.json has no marketplace/vendor package; README.md 'multi-vendor marketplace' line

pitfalls.detail: README says 'Built with Laravel and Vue.js' and AGENTS.md instructs the agent to load skills from .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (or .claude/skills/), but neither .agents/ nor .claude/ exists on branch 2.4 - the skills directory 404s, so an agent following AGENTS.md finds nothing to read.
pitfalls.evidence: api.github.com/repos/bagisto/bagisto/contents/.agents?ref=2.4 -> 404; .claude?ref=2.4 -> 404; recursive tree has no .agents/.claude paths (while .github and .editorconfig do appear)

pitfalls.detail: Install order matters and the dev Docker path hides it: docker-compose.yml builds laravel.test from ./vendor/laravel/sail/runtimes/8.3, a path that only exists AFTER composer install - `docker compose up` on a fresh clone fails until composer has run. Also APP_KEY is empty in .env.example, so any request before `php artisan key:generate` throws.

PHP extension wall: composer requires ext-calendar, curl, intl, mbstring, openssl, pdo, pdo_mysql, tokenizer and PHP >=8.3 <8.5 hard-capped. A host on PHP 8.2 or 8.5 cannot install even though Laravel 12 itself is looser.

composer post-autoload-dump runs `php artisan package:discover --ansi` on EVERY autoload dump - if the app is not yet configured (no .env/APP_KEY) this prints confusing errors during install and can hard-fail CI that only wanted to vendor the code.

Frontend deps live in THREE package.json files (packages/Webkul/Admin, Shop, Installer) plus a near-empty root one, and each pins its OWN vue/vite/tailwind/playwright versions (Shop pins @playwright/test ^1.57.0 while Admin and the root pin ^1.58.1; Admin also pulls vue-cal). 'npm install at the root' does not install the admin/storefront toolchain - agents then report phantom missing modules.
pitfalls.evidence: package.json (root) vs packages/Webkul/{Admin,Shop,Installer}/package.json; AGENTS.md 'Frontend assets build from within each package, not the root'

pitfalls.detail: 416 MB repo: 34 MB of committed Noto CJK webfonts in public/fonts, 5.4 MB of committed Vite build output under public/themes/*/build, a 6.35 MB demo-products.json and duplicated asset copies (every built asset also exists once as source under packages/Webkul/*/src/Resources/assets - e.g. side-bar-menu svg 1,173,653 B twice, hero-image jpg 792,772 B twice). A clone is slow and the duplicated bytes bloat any diff.
pitfalls.evidence: git tree byte sums: public/fonts 33,963,735 B; public/themes 5,436,448 B; packages/Webkul/Installer/src/Data/demo-products.json 6,352,274 B; duplicate svg/jpg paths

pitfalls.detail: Committed build output plus AGENTS.md's 'Do not edit public/themes/*/*/build/' means the Vite bundles in public/ can silently diverge from the sources under packages/*/src/Resources/assets - a template change looks applied but the served bundle is stale until you rebuild the right package.
pitfalls.evidence: AGENTS.md 'Do not edit' list; public/themes/*/build/assets/* present in the tree alongside the same files under src/Resources/assets/

pitfalls.detail: Search behaves differently by environment: without Elasticsearch the storefront falls back to the DB driver, but config/elasticsearch.php + Webkul/Core/src/ElasticSearch.php + indexer jobs still ship, so a dev who enables ES for one test can change product-listing behaviour and get confusing test drift.

192 migration files across 41 packages are applied as one global sequence by `php artisan migrate`; a package added or removed out of order leaves the schema half-built and the failure surfaces as a missing-table 500 deep in a page render, not at migrate time.

health.notes: open_issues 24 total but only 20 are real issues (4 are PRs). contributors 320 taken from the Link rel=last page count of repos/bagisto/bagisto/contributors (per_page=1 -> page 320). top_contributor_share = jitendra-webkul 6,394 contributions / 22,900 commits on branch 2.4 (Link rel=last on the commits endpoint) = 0.279. Very much alive: 269 commits and 53 merged PRs in the last 90 days, last release v2.4.12 on 2026-09-22, and a v2.5.0-beta4 line in flight. Branch layout is version-per-branch (1.x, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, master) - 2.4 is the maintained stable line and the default branch.

verdict.best_for: A business that needs a full self-hosted Laravel storefront fast - catalog/EAV, cart, one-page checkout, invoices/shipments/refunds, RMA, tax, 22 locales incl. RTL, multi-currency, 6 payment gateways, an admin with ACL and 2FA, Docker production images and a real Pest+Playwright suite - and is willing to work inside its 41-package conventions.
verdict.weak_for: Anyone assuming this repo is a multi-vendor marketplace (that is a separate paid extension), a JS/React app (it is Blade + Vue islands with 0 .vue files), or a small codebase they can read end-to-end - 2,621 package PHP files across 41 modules with a mandatory repository-pattern convention make deep changes a real onboarding project.
verdict.swap_burden: heavy - every theme, branding and business-rule change happens inside Bagisto's own package/Concord/repository conventions (no comments inside method bodies, all DB access through repositories, every user-facing string through trans() in 22 locales, and AGENTS.md forbids adding or removing Composer/npm dependencies without approval), and stripping features means removing whole modules plus their migrations.

unmeasured: Nothing was installed or executed (remote-API measurement only): I did not run composer install, npm install, php artisan migrate, the Pest suite or a Playwright run, so install success, migration success and the real green/red state of main are NOT verified.
loc_estimate 620,000 is byte-derived (PHP 22,241,138 B + Blade 5,077,584 B in packages/, assuming ~44 B/line), not a counted LOC.
complexity.pages 553 is the count of .blade.php view files (there is no 'pages' concept in PHP routing); complexity.components 41 is the package count, not UI components.

Route count 511 is a grep of `Route::` declarations in the 25 route files that contain them; packages can also register routes at runtime from service providers (Paypal/src/Routes/web.php declares none inline yet PayPal obviously works), so the true routable surface is somewhat higher.
TranslationsChecker / lang coverage: I did not run `php artisan bagisto:translations:check`, so whether all 22 locales are complete is unknown.
UPGRADE.md (55,922 B) was only read in its first ~40 lines; per-version breaking-change detail beyond v2.4 was not audited.
Whether the v2.5.0-beta line changes any of the above: I measured branch 2.4 (the default) only; master/2.5.0-beta4 were not measured.
DB model semantics: 243 files under packages/*/src/Models/ were counted, but I did not read the schema to confirm every one is a table-backed Eloquent model (Concord proxies included).
Payments 'model' is recorded as one-time because checkout is order-based; laravel/cashier is present in composer.json and its intended production use inside Bagisto was not traced.
Email template count 30 counts .blade.php files under */Resources/views/emails/ seen in the tree; per-gateway and per-locale variants were not resolved.
